description:
<!-- Modified by lavinhoque33, 2026-11-19. -->
## YouTube and YouTube Music

- **Spoof video streams:** Added Mobile Web, visionOS Experimental, and Android VR Experimental. Music also gains the standard Android VR option. The default remains visionOS. Mobile Web uses a signed-out session on compatible WebView versions; no separate sign-in is needed for it. (#67)

## YouTube

- **Shorts:** Toggle **Hide Shorts dimming** in RVX settings without repatching. Dimming stays on by default. (#65)
- **Snack bar:** Choose **Chip** for a theme-aware border or switch back to **Custom** without losing the saved color. A border width of zero keeps the border hidden. (#65)
- **About:** Patch information now distinguishes **Not recorded** from an explicit exclusion. (#65)

## YouTube Music

- **Player:** **Hide overlay filter** now also removes the dimming behind the Playback speed, Quality, and Sleep timer dialogs. (#65)

Update to **RVX Patches v1.42.0** in Morphe Manager and repatch your app to get these changes.
